predecessors.name: Yuezhi
predecessors.text: the Ili Valley and the Issyk-Kul basin: 'the Wusun drove the Yuezhi out of the Ili Valley and settled the area'; the royal court Chigu 'in a side valley leading to Issyk Kul'

ledger.x: 132 BC: the Wusun take the Ili Valley.
132 BC: the Yuezhi are driven from the Ili.

wars.name: Wusun conquest of the Ili Valley
wars.outcome: The Wusun, with Xiongnu support, drove the Yuezhi out of the Ili Valley and settled it.

wars.name: Xiongnu attack on the Wusun and the Han-Wusun campaign of 72 BC
wars.outcome: Around 80 BC the Xiongnu inflicted a devastating defeat on the Wusun; in 72 BC 'the joint forces of the Wusun and Han invaded the territory of the Luli King of the Right', and Han and Wusun together broke the Xiongnu.

certainty.note: Steppe and mountain valleys: the page gives no frontier line; the neighbours are described only by direction (Kangju to the north-west, Dayuan to the west).
